cohort: The study included data from 53 deliveries where patients experienced blood loss greater than 2500 mL due to placenta previa with or without placenta accreta spectrum disorders and the Matsubara-Takahashi cervix-holding technique was used.
finding: The Matsubara-Takahashi cervix-holding technique achieved hemostasis in 50% of patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorders and had an overall success rate of 75% for postpartum hemorrhage.
